question: Can the admitted nonsecret probe establish the precise host prerequisites and retain useful failed capability evidence without weakening publication custody?
decision: Keep the exact closed capability shape. Retain validated negative booleans and response identities in failed receipts, reject contradictory success summaries, and never use a negative result to clean or release uncertain state. Require file fsync and directory fsync after rename before declaring flush capability. Hold production execution for a fresh coordinated clean-source admission.

combined_pester.meaning: Complete existing custody/static-seed and new host-capability suites. Executed after the diagnostic fix and before only the PHP directory-fsync extension.

actual_php.scope: Actual directory fsync, refusal of file/symlink substitutes, all original success and rejection cases.

manifest_format_readback.meaning: Only existing two-space JSON formatting was restored after the functional suites; exact manifest source identities revalidated.

validation.coverage: The complete Pester run measured 504/763 existing module commands. AST-imported publisher functions are exercised behaviorally; no file/line coverage claim is made for them.
validation.scratch: Both canonical artifacts/tests and TinyRustLM artifacts/tests/minimodel-host-capability contained no remaining entries after owned cleanup. No earlier blocked output was touched.

independent_review.scope: Read-only full bounded probe publisher at 6afb0ac
independent_review.result: No material defect found in namespace custody, denial-before-code ordering, bounded HTTP body, reverse cleanup or ambiguity retention.

independent_review.scope: Final diagnostic and directory fsync follow-up
independent_review.result: Accepted source-level diff; full root transaction readback pending before live execution.

retained_failures.meaning: Earlier in-memory HTTP fixture output pollution; corrected fixture, retained in prior checkpoint.

limits: Local Docker/Pester success does not establish live PHP, denial, rewrite, TLS or storage capability.
Parsed HTTP checks do not prove exact raw-wire header syntax.
Live execution requires fresh clean/remote-exact canonical admission and the exact bound account, sentinel and lease.
Any failed or ambiguous live namespace is retained for exact review; no blind retry or broad deletion.
A later renewal namespace must independently demonstrate HTTP denial before receiving any real key.
No real model qualification or usable public default is claimed.
reusable_lesson: Treat durability and diagnostics as measured contracts: file-only flush is insufficient, and a negative fixed-shape capability result should remain inspectable without leaking arbitrary server output.
